qa_pairs.question: Where is the idle speed actuator located in the engine compartment?
qa_pairs.answer: The idle speed actuator is located at the top center front of the engine, as shown in Figure 1.

qa_pairs.question: What component is visible on the left-hand front of the engine?
qa_pairs.answer: The alternator is visible on the left-hand front of the engine, as shown in Figure 3.

qa_pairs.question: Where are the LH and RH jet heaters positioned?
qa_pairs.answer: The LH jet heater and RH jet heater are positioned in the center of the engine compartment hood, as shown in Figure 5.

qa_pairs.question: What fuel system component is shown at the top of the engine in Figure 2?
qa_pairs.answer: The fuel injectors are shown at the top of the engine in Figure 2.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the throttle switch located?
qa_pairs.answer: The throttle switch is located at the top center front of the engine, as shown in Figure 1.

qa_pairs.question: What auxiliary component is located behind the center of the front bumper?
qa_pairs.answer: The auxiliary fan and auxiliary fan normal speed blower resistor are located behind the center of the front bumper, as shown in Figure 4.

qa_pairs.question: What component labeled G106 is shown in the engine compartment?
qa_pairs.answer: Component G106 is located in the right-hand front corner of the engine compartment, as shown in Figure 6.

qa_pairs.question: How many different engine compartment views are provided on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: There are 6 different engine compartment views provided on this page, labeled as Figures 1 through 6.
